verdict.rationale: ImageMagick's own CLI chains operations in a single command, for example converting PNG to WebP with compression in one `magick` call, and it is documented as having a scripting-first design for mass batch jobs. That covers the convert-then-optimize portion of a job. There is no first-party job or pipeline definition, watched-folder trigger, or delivery step. Multi-step workflows rely on user-written bash scripts, which are a user-side workaround and earn no credit. Missing for 10: delivery/output-destination step, watched-folder or trigger-based workflow, named reusable job definitions, and documentation of multi-stage pipeline orchestration.
